checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.text: After this many Jobs from one cause (your message, a schedule, a change to a table), that work pauses and the Inbox asks whether it goes on. Raising it lets agents spend more before you are asked.

filesLimit.title: Files
filesLimit.text: How much the files agents' tools return, and the files of your tables, may take on this install's disk in all. Past it, a tool result's files are refused and the agent is told why; files already kept stay.

strict.title: Permissions
strict.label: Enable strict permissions
strict.off: Off, a choice remembered for future runs (an approval kept for all future runs, an action an agent runs without asking) holds until its tool is moved to another address or transport.
strict.on: On, it also holds only while the tool lists the same actions with the same schemas, its plugin stays at the same commit, its skill’s files and its agent’s configuration are unchanged, and the tool answers its listing: otherwise it asks again. Turning it on makes the choices remembered while it was off ask again.

limits.title: Sessions at once
limits.text: How many of each harness's sessions may work at the same time. Past it, Jobs wait their turn; none is dropped. Raising it lets agents spend more.

native.warning: Complete native installation can run plugin hooks, commands, programs and MCP servers with the runner account's access. It affects the whole plugin, including skills you did not import. Review and trust its source first.
native.unavailable: Native installation unavailable; enable native plugin support on this runner and check that the CLI account is available
native.noTargets: Add a CLI harness and enable native plugin support on its runner first.
native.skillsOnly: This installs the workspace package as a skills-only native plugin through Skillshare. Its files can include scripts. Only the owner can approve installation.
native.removeNote: Uninstall removes the whole native plugin from this runner / harness pair. Its workspace skills, tools and agents stay available.
native.blocked: Skillshare blocked this change. Refresh inventory and check the runner’s native account configuration before trying again.
native.failed: Native operation failed. Refresh inventory before retrying; some changes may have completed.
native.done: Native operation completed. Reload the harness and complete any native authentication or trust prompts.
native.shared: Native installations are shared by all {{cli}} harnesses on {{runner}}. Sessions use matching, enabled native skills; otherwise they load the stripped workspace copy.
